plan.summary: This 4-week block starts a 12-week off-camp build for boxing with one focused S&C session each week to support heavier sparring and skill work. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lift so future loading can be more accurate, and the main training work starts in Week 2. With only one 45-minute session per week, the plan keeps the highest-value work: a power primer, one main strength lift, one upper-body push-pull pairing, and brief trunk work.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body force and total-body power with simple, high-quality work that does not interfere with sparring.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength lift and keep power output sharp while holding total fatigue in check.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift toward faster strength-speed and cleaner power expression without forcing a fight-camp speed peak.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your training max for future weeks.
